title: eCommerce Dashboard
summary: eCommerce dashboard featuring a welcome banner with greeting and illustration at top-left, four stat pills for transactions (orders, profit, expenses, income), total profit area chart with year-over-year legend, and total sales card with prominent dollar amount, buy-now button, and mini bar chart. Second row has transaction summary cards with payment method icons, new visitors line chart with total count, and a transaction breakdown donut chart with category percentages. Bottom section includes a full-width data table of recent orders (ID, status, client, total, date columns) and a meeting schedule sidebar with upcoming events.

layout.columns: 12-column grid: top row has welcome banner (4 cols), stat pills (4 cols), total profit chart (4 cols), and total sales card (4 cols) wrapped; middle row has transactions list (4 cols), new visitors chart (4 cols), transaction donut (4 cols); bottom row has orders table (8 cols) and meeting schedule (4 cols)
